name: oil painting
definition: pigment bound in a drying oil, on canvas, panel or similar support.

name: acrylic painting
definition: pigment bound in acrylic polymer emulsion.

name: watercolour
definition: transparent pigment in gum arabic, applied wet, normally on paper.

name: gouache
definition: opaque, chalk-bodied water-based colour, normally on paper.

name: ink wash painting
definition: black or coloured ink brushed in graded washes on paper or silk, in the East Asian manner (named form: ink-and-colour painting).

name: mineral-pigment painting (nihonga)
definition: ground mineral pigments fixed with animal glue on paper or silk.

name: tempera painting
definition: pigment bound in egg yolk or another egg or glue medium, usually on a prepared panel.

name: encaustic painting
definition: pigment in hot beeswax, fused to a support.

name: fresco (detached or transferred)
definition: pigment applied to wet or dry lime plaster, now removed from its wall.

name: mixed-media painting
definition: a painting in which several paint media or added materials are used together and the image is painted, not built from pasted elements.

name: spray-paint painting
definition: image made mainly with aerosol or spray paint (graffiti-derived work on canvas, panel or other support).

name: graphite (pencil) drawing
definition: image drawn with graphite pencils.

name: charcoal drawing
definition: image drawn with charcoal.

name: pastel drawing
definition: image drawn with pigment sticks (soft pastel, oil pastel) on paper or similar ground.

name: coloured-pencil drawing
definition: image drawn with pigmented pencils.

name: pen-and-ink drawing
definition: image drawn with pen, nib or marker in ink; illustration and comic pages in this medium are here.

name: woodcut
definition: image cut with knives and gouges into the side grain of a wood block (named form: ukiyo-e colour woodblock print).

name: linocut
definition: image cut into a linoleum sheet.

name: wood engraving
definition: image cut with gravers into the end grain of a hardwood block.

name: etching
definition: lines bitten into a coated metal plate with acid.

name: line engraving
definition: lines cut into a metal plate with a burin.

name: drypoint
definition: lines scratched directly into a plate with a needle, no acid.

name: mezzotint
definition: plate roughened all over with a rocker, then burnished from dark to light.

name: aquatint
definition: tone made by acid biting through a porous ground of resin dust.

name: stone lithograph
definition: image drawn with greasy medium on limestone and printed from the stone.

name: offset lithograph
definition: image transferred from a plate through a rubber blanket to paper, as a fine-art edition.

name: screenprint
definition: ink pushed through a mesh stencil, one stencil per colour (named form: paper screen).

name: monotype
definition: a single unique impression pulled from a painted or inked blank surface.

name: monoprint
definition: a unique impression from a reusable matrix, varied by inking or additions each time.

name: collagraph
definition: print from a plate built up by gluing materials onto a board.

name: inkjet print
definition: image sprayed from a print head with pigment or dye inks onto paper, canvas or another sheet (aliases: giclee, digital print; fine-art reproductions of paintings made this way are here).

name: gelatin silver print
definition: silver halide in a gelatin layer on paper, exposed and developed in a darkroom.

name: daguerreotype
definition: image on a silvered copper plate.

name: chromogenic print
definition: colour dyes formed in layers of colour paper by development (C-print, Lambda print).

name: dye-transfer print
definition: colour made by transferring dyes from matrices onto paper.

name: silver dye bleach print
definition: colour dyes already in the paper, bleached away where not wanted (named form: Ilfochrome).

name: archival pigment print
definition: pigment inkjet print of a photograph on fine-art paper.

name: platinum or palladium print
definition: image in platinum or palladium metal on paper.

name: cyanotype
definition: iron-salt print giving a blue image.

name: tintype
definition: positive image on a thin iron plate.

name: photogram
definition: image made without a camera by placing objects on light-sensitive material.

name: instant print
definition: self-developing print from an instant camera or film pack (named form: Polaroid).

name: bronze sculpture
definition: cast copper-tin alloy, usually patinated.

name: steel and iron sculpture
definition: sculpture of steel, iron or other ferrous metal that is welded, forged, cut or bent (welded or forged is an attribute).

name: pewter and other cast-metal figurine
definition: ornamental figure cast in pewter, zinc, tin or other non-bronze metal.

name: stone carving
definition: marble, limestone, alabaster or other stone carved to form.

name: jade carving
definition: figure or object carved from jade.

name: wood carving
definition: carved from wood (named form: netsuke).

name: ivory and bone carving
definition: carved from ivory, bone, horn or antler (named form: scrimshaw).

name: terracotta sculpture
definition: modelled or moulded clay fired without a glaze.

name: glazed earthenware and stoneware sculpture and figurine
definition: glazed fired clay other than porcelain.

name: porcelain and bone china figurine and sculpture
definition: figure or sculpture in porcelain or bone china.

name: glass and crystal sculpture and figurine
definition: blown, cast, fused or cut glass or lead crystal figure or sculpture (named form: Murano glass).

name: resin sculpture and figurine
definition: cast resin figure or sculpture, usually painted.

name: plaster sculpture
definition: cast or modelled plaster.

name: wax sculpture
definition: modelled or cast wax.

name: soft sculpture
definition: three-dimensional sculpture of fabric, fibre or other soft material, stuffed, wrapped or stitched.

name: found-object assemblage
definition: sculpture assembled from found, salvaged or discarded objects, or from several materials none of which governs (named form: junk sculpture).

name: neon sculpture
definition: sculpture in which a lit gas-discharge tube or equivalent light source is the medium.

name: tapestry
definition: picture or pattern woven on a loom to hang on a wall.

name: embroidered picture
definition: picture worked in thread with a needle on a fabric ground (named form: sampler).

name: brush and pen calligraphy
definition: writing made as the picture, in brush or pen script (East Asian script styles, Arabic calligraphy, Western calligraphy); hanging scroll and handscroll are mount attributes.

name: collage
definition: picture built from pasted or bonded elements (paper, cloth, photographs, found flat material).

name: mosaic picture
definition: picture set in small pieces (tesserae) of stone, glass or ceramic.
